It had much higher health than all enemies that appeared before it, but it was also significantly slower. The '''Executioner''' had one ability where it threw its axe at a random tower, stunning any tower hit by it. In the first act, it was a boss enemy, making it immune to being slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]], immune to freezing and could only be slowed down by the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]]. It had none of these immunities in the third act. ==Appearance== The '''Executioner''' was a plushie version of the Level 5 {{Color|Eclipse|Eclipse}} [[Executioner]]. It had a dark purple helmet with horns with blue glow inside of it, dark purple shoulder-pads, chestplate and leg padding. It had yellow button kneepads, a purple belt and a giant yellow button on its torso. It also wore purple gloves and shoes. The '''Executioner''' wielded a large grey and red axe which it used to attack towers. ==Strategy== *Multiple lower level DPS towers, like Level 2 [[Minigunner]]s, [[Golden Minigunner]]s or Level 2-3 [[Accelerator]]s can be very useful against the '''Executioner'''. **Multiple weaker towers, such as multiple Level 3-4 [[Golden Scout]]s, Level 3-4 [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Militant]]s can also be quite useful. **Towers that cannot be stunned by the '''Executioner's''' ability, like the [[Pursuit]], are particularly effective against it. *Placing down cheap towers as a distraction, such as a [[Scout]] or [[Golden Scout]], can be very helpful by distracting the '''Executioner's''' axe from hitting your offensive towers. **However, this may not be viable in [[The Great Finale]], due to limited space on this map. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750

12 (Nil Zone) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]20,000 |shield_hp = [[File:ShieldHealth.png|20px|Shield Health]]55,000 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slow (1.75) |defense = {{Defense}}25% |cash = {{Money|1,000}} every 1% health |spawned_by = [[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)|Mechanical Rot]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{BossList|Ref = Only the first '''Executioner''' is a [[Boss]] enemy.|Default}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Head Chopping}}''' - The '''Executioner''' throws its axe at a random tower, stunning any tower hit by it. }} ==Description== The '''Executioner''', internally referred to as '''Executioner Plush''', is a boss in [[Pizza Party]], debuting on Wave 35. It has an extremely high amount of health and walks at a slow speed. The '''Executioner''' has one ability where it throws its axe at a random tower, stunning any tower hit by it. ==Appearance== The '''Executioner''' is a plushie version of the Level 5 {{Color|Eclipse|Eclipse}} [[Executioner]]. It has a dark purple helmet with horns with blue glow inside of it, dark purple shoulder-pads, chestplate and leg padding. It has yellow button kneepads, a purple belt and a giant yellow button on its torso. It also wears purple gloves and shoes. The '''Executioner''' wields a large grey and red axe which it uses to attack towers. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]], [[Engineer]] and [[Turret]] are recommended to take this enemy down. **The [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] can be used to boost these towers. *The [[Medic]] can be used to shield towers, preventing them from being stunned by the '''Executioner's''' ''Head Chopping'' ability. **Alternatively, you can place cheap towers along the path to divert the ability away from your main damage towers. **You can also use towers that are immune to stuns, such as the [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]]. *When it first spawns, it is a boss enemy, limiting the amount of towers that can slow it down. **Confusion, Slowness, and poison effects cannot slow it down at all, so using towers with these effects to stall it is not advised on its debut wave. **Freezing towers cannot freeze it, but can still slow it down through chill. *Cheap towers can be placed on the side of the map to bait the '''Executioner''', making it target insignificant towers instead of your main DPS towers. **It can also be used to stall the '''Executioner'''. While performing its ability, it will stop moving, giving you more time to kill it. This, however, requires towers to be in range, which makes it pretty useful to have a cheap distraction tower near it at all times. Regardless, this is not mandatory. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:ExecutionerSwing.ogg]] |When the '''Executioner''' performs ''Head Chopping'' ability |- |[[File:AxeHit.ogg]] |When the '''Executioner''' performs ''Head Chopping'' ability |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ExecutionerWalk.gif|Walking animation (22 January 2025 – Present) ExecutionerThrow.gif|''Head Chopping'' animation (22 January 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Exe.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variant

Pierce |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]75 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]6.025 (Firerate)
[[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.1 (Tick) |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]32 |speed = 2 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |flying = {{Attr|Flying|Yes}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Executioner Skeleton''' is a unit spawned by the [[Necromancer]]'s Level 3 gravestones and randomly from dead enemies while the [[Necromancer's Tome (Consumable)|Necromancer's Tome]] consumable is active. It is a high health unit which has a strong attack. When enemies are within range, the '''Executioner Skeleton''' will stop moving to throw its axe, which will travel in a straight line. When in flight, the axe deals 100 damage every 0.1 seconds to any enemy caught in it, which can deal hundreds of damage to multiple enemies if the trajectory is right. This makes it quite powerful on certain maps with paths that facilitate the ability. Once the axe returns and no other enemies are in range, the '''Executioner Skeleton''' will continue moving. Overall, the unit's high health and strong attack make it quite powerful. ==Appearance== The '''Executioner Skeleton''' is made entirely of white parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid. It does not have a full torso, but instead has the bone cage for it. Its head is slightly smaller than most other enemies and has two large black eyeholes. It wears a brown belt, brown torn cape, grey crown and shoulder-pads, and grey knee-pads, armbands and chestplate, which have a black skull with blue glowing eyes. It wields a large black axe with a black skull which has blue eyes. ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:MageExecutionerSkeleton.png|175px]] |[[File:FallenExecutionerSkeleton.png|175px]] |[[File:DuckExecutionerSkeleton.png|175px]] |[[File:CreepySantaExecutionerSkeleton.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Deluxe|Mage}} |{{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} |{{Color|DuckyRevenge|Duck}} |{{Color|FinalAct|Creepy Santa}} |- !Obtained From |[[Deluxe Crate]] |[[Mission Quests]] |[[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge Premium Battle Pass]] |[[The Final Act Event#The Final Act Battle Pass|The Final Act Regular Battle Pass]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Executioner Skeleton''' has a high amount of health, making it useful against hordes of enemies, like the [[Molten]], [[Fallen]] or [[Monkey]]. **It can also be quite useful at killing or weakening higher health enemies, such as the [[Fallen Giant]] or [[Molten Titan]]. **The '''Executioner Skeleton''', despite its high health, should not be used exclusively for its collision damage, as its ranged attack is also quite powerful. *The '''Executioner Skeleton''' will throw its axe at an enemy, quickly dealing high damage to enemies hit by it. **However, do note that the axe always travels a specific distance in a straight line. This means that in some situations it could go through a line full of enemies, while in others it could hit just a few enemies, making it quite inconsistent. *The '''Executioner Skeleton''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Bulwark]] or [[Fallen Jester]]. *The '''Executioner Skeleton''' can cope well against enemies that deal damage to units with their abilities due to its high health. **However, it will be completely destroyed if the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)

==Description==
The '''Damage Buff''' is a buff that increases a tower's damage, making them stronger. It is displayed on the tower itself with the icon of an arm with muscle.

==Mechanics==
'''Damage Buff''' range reduction is calculated as:
::<big>'''Damage × (1 + Damage Buff)'''</big>
:::where '''Damage Buff''' is the debuff supplied in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

The damage increased by the '''Damage Buff''' will always round down to the nearest integer. For example, a tower that deals 5 damage with a 50% '''Damage Buff''' will deal 7 damage, instead of 7.5.

Multiple towers are not fully affected by the buff. A full list of towers affected fully, partially or that are unaffected can be found below.
{{DamageBuff}}

title: Firerate Bug
wikitext_excerpt:
{{Removed|date = 6th of June 2026}}
{{Improve|this page and majority of tower/unit pages require updating}}
The '''Firerate Bug''', also known as the '''RoF (Rate of Fire) Bug''', was a bug that slightly increased the firerate of all towers and units. This increase was not displayed on the statistics in the game. This bug significantly affected the statistics of fast-firing towers, such as the [[Minigunner]] and [[Ace Pilot]], by significantly decreasing their DPS, whereas slow-firing towers like the [[Ranger]] or [[Sniper]] were hardly affected.

This has been fixed as of the 6th of June 2026, and all firerate statistics in the game are considered to be accurate unless affected by a different unrelated bug.

{{RightTOC}}

==Prior to 5th of June 2026==
The '''Firerate Bug''' affects all towers and units that can directly attack enemies, meaning the only towers that are not affected are the [[Farm]], [[Medic]] and the [[Firework Technician]] and the only units that are not affected are the [[Humvee]], [[Humvee 2]], [[Elf]], [[Bomber Elf (Unit)|Bomber Elf]], [[Skeleton (Unit)|Skeleton]], [[Giant Skeleton (Unit)|Giant Skeleton]] and [[Hallow Guard (Unit)|Hallow Guard]]. The '''Firerate Bug''' does not affect the firerate of some secondary attacks towers or units may perform, some damage-over-time effects applied by towers (like burn from the [[Pyromancer]]) or certain other cooldowns.

The '''Firerate Bug''' increases the firerate of a tower/unit depending on its firerate, which can vary anywhere between 0.017 and 0.032 seconds. The firerate increase affects fast firing towers the most; for example, the [[Minigunner]] at Level 4 should have a firerate of 0.09, but because of the '''Firerate Bug''', it has a firerate of about 0.117, decreasing its DPS from 166.67 to 128.20, which is a decrease of 38.47 DPS, or a loss of about 23.08 DPS. Meanwhile, slow firing towers are barely affected by it; for example, the [[Ranger]] at Level 4 should have a firerate of 8, but because of the '''Firerate Bug''', it has a firerate of about 8.025, decreasing its DPS from 156.26 to 155.76, which is a decrease of 0.30 DPS, or a loss of 0.2% DPS.

The [[Firerate Buff]] is also affected by the '''Firerate Bug''', making it less effective. For example, the Level 4 [[Minigunner]] without the '''Firerate Bug''' with a 50% firerate boost should have a firerate of 0.06, but with the '''Firerate Bug''' it has a firerate of 0.083. This means that its DPS with a 50% firerate boost is decreased from 250 to 180.72, which is a decrease of 69.28 DPS, or a loss of 27.71% DPS.

On this Wiki, the firerate statistic of all towers and units is increased by specific values based on the firerate. While technically possible to calculate by hand, due to the effort it would take, it is overall recommended to either use [[Help:Neowtext#ROFBUG|Neowtext]] or [https://fiheron.github.io/dps-calc/ an online calculator].

==Prior to the 9th of January 2023==
Prior to the 9th of January 2023, the firerate increase caused by the '''Firerate Bug''' for units was higher than it currently is. The firerate increase was generally around 0.03 seconds. For towers, the firerate increase remained at around 0.008 seconds.

On this Wiki, the firerate statistic of all towers and units after the [[V1.6.0|Violent Night Update]] and before the 9th of January 2023 is increased by 0.008 and 0.03 respectively, unless stated otherwise. This does not, however, mean the actual value is this; it can vary between towers and even between matches.

==Prior to the Violent Night Update==
Prior to the [[V1.6.0|Violent Night Update]], the firerate increase caused by the '''Firerate Bug''' for units was lower than it was before the [[V1.6.0|Violent Night Update]]. The firerate increases could be anywhere between 0.008 and 0.017 seconds, but the increase was generally around 0.008 seconds. This is the same as the current situation.

Build up chill to slow and freeze enemies in their tracks!|Store Description}} |-|Version 3 = {{QuoteBox|Chill enemies to a slow freeze!|Store Description}} |-|Version 2 = {{QuoteBox|Shoot an ice beam, freezing targets for a few seconds.|Store Description}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Freeze zombies temporarily with a freeze ray!|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Freezer''' is a ground [[Towers|tower]] that fires an ice beam and applies chill and slow down enemies, freezing at later levels. It can be bought in the store for {{Coins|650}}. The '''Freezer''' targets a single enemy and fires a ''Frost Ray'', chilling the enemy and slowing it down. The chillness slowness effect stacks with each hit multiple times. This chillness effect also deals damage over time, chipping away the health of enemies affected by it. Starting from Level 2, it can freeze enemies. When the chillness slowness effect is higher than the max slowdown, the enemy will be frozen, which generally when targeting a single enemy takes four or five shots. Larger enemies will be frozen for a shorter amount of time than average sized enemies. Enemies with [[Freeze Immunity]] also cannot be frozen, slowed down or have their defense dropped by the '''Freezer'''. At Level 3+, the '''Freezer''' fires in bursts, with a short delay between them. Additionally, at Level 3+, it drops defense by 10% every tick. It can only decrease an enemy's defense by 33%. For example, if an enemy has 50% defense, it will be decreased by 16%. On top of this, it will also start dealing damage over time with its chill at Level 3. Additionally at Level 4, the '''Freezer''' gains the ability to throw a '''Frost Grenade''', freezing enemies within an explosion radius. The '''Freezer''' does well as an all-rounder support tower. Due to its generally low price and decent DPS, the '''Freezer''' can be a solid choice for early-game defense to mid game with very good cost efficiency. Towards late game, the '''Freezer''' is useful for stalling, defense melting and deal additional DPS through its damage over time, though its DPS is insufficient to deal with late-game waves alone. The '''Freezer''' has [[Lead (Attribute)|lead]] detection from Level 0 and [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] detection from level 2.
